WITH filtered_date AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c_last_name, 
        c_first_name 
    FROM 
        store_sales 
    JOIN 
        filtered_date ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk
    JOIN 
        customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        c_last_name, 
        c_first_name 
    FROM 
        catalog_sales 
    JOIN 
        filtered_date ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk
    JOIN 
        customer ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        c_last_name, 
        c_first_name 
    FROM 
        web_sales 
    JOIN 
        filtered_date ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk
    JOIN 
        customer ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name FROM filtered_sales GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name HAVING COUNT(*) = 3
) AS hot_cust LIMIT 100
